Stir briefly.

name: Conquistador
description: A creamy tequila and coffee dessert cocktail.
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice.
Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.

name: Chi-Chi
description: A vodka Piña Colada.
steps: Blend all ingredients with a cup of ice until smooth.
Pour into a hurricane glass.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge.

name: Vodka Sour
description: A straightforward vodka sour.
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice.
Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.

name: Greyhound
description: Vodka and grapefruit, unrimmed.
steps: Build both ingredients over ice in a highball glass.
Stir gently.

name: Cape Codder
description: Vodka, cranberry, and a squeeze of lime.
steps: Build all ingredients over ice in a highball glass.
Stir gently.

name: Madras
description: Vodka with cranberry and orange juice.
steps: Build all ingredients over ice in a highball glass.
Stir gently.

name: Woo Woo
description: Vodka, peach schnapps, and cranberry.
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice.
Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.

name: Sex on the Beach
description: A fruity vodka and peach schnapps highball.
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice.
Strain over fresh ice in a highball glass.

name: Fuzzy Navel
description: Peach schnapps and orange juice, easygoing and sweet.
steps: Build both ingredients over ice in a highball glass.
Stir gently.

name: Pink Squirrel
description: A pastel, almond-forward dessert cocktail.

ingredients.substituteNotes: White crème de cacao keeps the pink colour.

steps: Shake all ingredients with ice.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Spiced Apple Cider (Warm, Non-Alcoholic)
description: A warming, spiced zero-proof cider.
steps: Warm pressed apple with ginger syrup and cinnamon in a saucepan.
Pour into a warmed mug.
Garnish with a cinnamon stick.

name: Grapefruit Rosemary Spritz (Non-Alcoholic)
description: A bright, herbal zero-proof spritz.
steps: Muddle rosemary with honey syrup in a shaker.
Add grapefruit juice, shake with ice.
Strain into a wine glass over ice.
Top with club soda.
Garnish with a rosemary sprig.

name: Salty Chihuahua
description: A tequila Greyhound, rimmed with salt.
steps: Build tequila and grapefruit juice over ice in a salt-rimmed highball glass.
Stir gently.

name: Batanga
description: A rustic tequila and cola highball, stirred with a knife.
steps: Build tequila and lime juice over ice in a salt-rimmed highball glass.
Top with cola and stir.

name: Ranch Water
description: A minimal, bone-dry tequila and soda cooler.
steps: Build tequila and lime juice over ice in a highball glass.
Top with club soda.

name: Bamboo
description: A dry, sherry-based aperitif classic.
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Adonis
description: A sherry and sweet vermouth aperitif, gentle and dry.
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish with an orange twist.

name: Widow's Kiss
description: An opulent apple brandy classic layered with herbal liqueurs.
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Cable Car
description: A spiced-rum Sidecar variant with a cinnamon-sugar rim.
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice.
Double strain into a cinnamon-sugar-rimmed chilled coupe.

name: Jamaican Mule
description: A funky dark-rum riff on the Moscow Mule.
steps: Build dark rum and lime juice over ice in a copper mug or highball.
Top with ginger beer.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Gin & Tonic
description: The highball that needs no introduction.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add gin, then top with tonic water.
Stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Vodka Tonic
description: A clean, bitter-edged vodka highball.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add vodka, then top with tonic water.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Espresso Tonic
description: Espresso floated over tonic: bitter, bright and alcohol-free.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice and tonic water.
Slowly pour fresh espresso over the top so it floats.
Garnish with an orange twist.

name: Hugo Spritz
description: A South Tyrolean spritz of elderflower, mint and Prosecco.

ingredients.substituteNotes: The original uses elderflower syrup; the liqueur adds a little strength.

steps: Gently press the mint leaves in a wine glass.
Add elderflower liqueur and ice.
Top with Prosecco and a splash of soda.
Garnish with a lime wheel.

name: Elderflower Collins
description: A Tom Collins softened with elderflower.
steps: Shake gin, elderflower liqueur, lemon juice and simple syrup with ice.
Strain into a collins glass over fresh ice.
Top with club soda.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Elderflower G&T
description: A floral twist on the Gin & Tonic.
steps: Fill a wine glass with ice.
Add gin and elderflower liqueur.
Top with tonic water and stir once.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Sloe Gin Fizz
description: Tart, jammy sloe gin lengthened with soda.
steps: Shake sloe gin, lemon juice and simple syrup with ice.
Strain into a highball glass over fresh ice.
Top with club soda.

name: Sloe Gin & Tonic
description: A ruby, low-strength highball for sloe gin.
steps: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add sloe gin, then top with tonic water.
Garnish with an orange wheel.

name: Blackthorn
description: A Savoy-era stirred drink of sloe gin and sweet vermouth.
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Rusty Nail
description: Scotch sweetened with honeyed, herbal Drambuie.
steps: Build Scotch and Drambuie over a large ice cube in a rocks glass.
Stir until chilled.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Bobby Burns
description: A Rob Roy rounded out with Bénédictine.
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Cynar Spritz
description: A bittersweet, vegetal take on the aperitivo spritz.
steps: Fill a wine glass with ice.
Add Cynar and Prosecco.
Top with a splash of club soda.
Garnish with an orange wheel.

name: Little Italy
description: A Manhattan deepened with Cynar.
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish with a cherry.

name: Trident
description: An equal-parts Negroni riff of aquavit, Cynar and fino sherry.

ingredients.substituteNotes: The original uses peach bitters.

steps: Stir all ingredients with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Danish Mary
description: A Bloody Mary with caraway-scented aquavit in place of vodka.
steps: Roll aquavit, tomato juice, lemon juice, Worcestershire and hot sauce between two shakers with ice.
Season with celery salt and black pepper.
Pour into a highball glass over fresh ice.
Garnish with a lemon wedge.

name: Amaro Sour
description: A rich, bittersweet sour built on a dark amaro.
steps: Dry shake all ingredients without ice.
Shake again with ice.
Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.
Garnish with an orange twist.

name: Greenpoint
description: A Manhattan riff with yellow Chartreuse.
steps: Stir all ingredients with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Caipirinha
description: Brazil's national cocktail: cachaça, lime and sugar, muddled.

ingredients.substituteNotes: Traditionally two teaspoons of white sugar, muddled with the lime.

steps: Cut the lime into wedges and muddle with simple syrup in a rocks glass.
Fill with crushed ice.
Add cachaça and stir well.

name: Mudslide
description: A frozen-dessert-style mix of vodka, coffee liqueur and Irish cream.
steps: Shake all ingredients with ice.
Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.

name: Nutty Irishman
description: Irish cream and hazelnut liqueur in hot coffee, crowned with cream.
steps: Pour Irish cream and hazelnut liqueur into a warmed mug.
Top with hot coffee and stir.
Float lightly whipped cream on top.

name: Café Corretto
description: Espresso "corrected" with a shot of sambuca.
steps: Pull a shot of espresso into a small cup.
Add the sambuca, or serve it alongside to pour in.
Garnish with three coffee beans, if you like.
